scope: Coding-agent review of exposed dev answers against unchanged gold and retrieved evidence; not independent expert or clinical validation.

criteria: All asked facts, group, units and conditions must be clear; a correct number inside an ambiguous/overbroad answer is partial. Labels matching after protocol failure are not proof of correct abstention reasoning.
